text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — PR #4822 (sdk snippet: streaming example) is green but needs a reviewer to force-merge; docs preview queue is full until ~3am PT.
Jordan Lee: I can take a look now but I have to step away at 10pm. If it looks tiny I'll approve.
Ravi Kumar: FYI the linkcheck CI has been flaky; yesterday a stray nbsp in frontmatter caused a preview failure even though local linkcheck passed.
Priya Shah: Quick question — can we enable auto-merge for trivial docs fixes? I thought we had a short list but security policy blocks it for a11y or legal-touching files.
Docs CI Bot: Preview instance queued (position 6). Estimated start in ~45m. Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/4822 (ephemeral).
Alex (oncall): If no one else can, I can do a fast sanity pass and merge after linkcheck. I can be on call till midnight PT.
Maya Patel: Alex, could you run a quick linkcheck before merging: `./scripts/linkcheck.sh docs/sdk/streaming.md` — if it returns 0 please proceed with `gh pr merge 4822 --squash` and add a short merge-note.
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: leaving a note for rotation owners — we still have a coverage gap for late-night merges. We should add a fallback list for after-hours.
Priya Shah: Happy to cover Thurs+Fri nights this week. I'll post in #docs rotation and add a tiny RFC proposing a `night-merge` volunteer tag.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — Alex merged while I was typing. I'll open an issue to track the linkcheck flakiness and propose a small CI retry wrapper.
Alex (oncall): Merged and left comment about manual check. If linkcheck reruns fail later, ping me or set `docs:urgent` label and I'll prioritize.
